description.value: Best Western Terrace Inn is a fully renovated, 100% non-smoking hotel on Greig Avenue in Terrace, BC, described by the property as the town's finest hotel with personalized service. Guest rooms feature 42-inch LED TVs, new bed linens, an upgraded A/C system, and both wireless and wired internet access. The hotel also includes over 4,500 square feet of meeting and event space accommodating up to 240 people, making it a full-service option in the Skeena River region of BC's North Coast.
